does: Puts a loaded dummy's visual into a scene: when the dummy has a visual resource and its entity is alive it attaches the entity's visual to the scene given as the third parameter.

evidence.says: It tests the dummy's 0x54 against the empty id, reads the entity's scene data and calls ls::VisualHelpers::AttachToScene with the scene; the Toolkit's ecl::TLPreviewDummyHelpers::AttachDummyToScene(WorldView&, TLPreviewDummy*, Scene*) has the same parameters.
A probe while a dialog starts records 27 calls, each from one of the two callbacks the timeline system runs when a dummy's load has ended, with the level's scene as the third argument.
